title: A decision about one story is history once the story ends
situation: Raised by the lead realizing intent-based delegation, 2026-10-15. A dropped story is not done, but decisions about it no longer stand either.
decision: A decision about one story, its scope, a ruling on its examples or its acceptance, is history once that story ends, merged or dropped: it records how the story went and no longer stands as a rule. A rule meant to outlast a story is stated in a concept or in a decision about the design itself. The decisions already history about finished cuts stay history.
